request.text: Please remind me at 7:30 p.m. this Thursday to submit my history essay. The deadline is 8:00 p.m., so don't set the reminder for the deadline.

responsibilities.outcome: Create one reminder to submit the history essay at 7:30 p.m. this Thursday, distinct from the 8:00 p.m. deadline.

semantic_facts: Exactly one reminder should be prepared for 7:30 p.m. this Thursday with submission of the history essay as its subject.
The stated 8:00 p.m. deadline is contextual constraint information and must not replace the requested reminder time.
forbidden_claims: The reminder is scheduled for 8:00 p.m.
A different day, time, assignment, or additional reminder is substituted.

target.claim_boundary: assistant-authored candidate oracle; not independently reviewed

negative_hypotheses: A nearby deadline value overrides the explicitly requested reminder time.
A precise single reminder is broadened into extra or differently timed work.
